description: This file defines the 'File' class within the 'ZipStream\Option' namespace, representing options for files in a ZIP archive, including properties like comment, method, deflate level, timestamp, and size, along with related getter and setter methods.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents configuration options for a file in a ZIP archive, including comment, compression method, deflate level, timestamp, and file size.

methods.name: defaultTo
methods.description: Sets default values for deflate level and timestamp based on the provided archive options.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the file.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the file.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the compression method used for the file.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the compression method for the file.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with the file.

methods.name: setTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.
